avoid_dishes.reason: These are different bases from the GF one. Don't assume they are gluten-free.

name: Circle of Crust
questions: What is the gluten-free crust made of? Any oat flour?
Is the GF crust made in-house or bought in?
Is it baked on a separate tray?
Are any toppings or sauces made with flour?
quinoa_oat_flags: The ingredients of the GF crust are unknown. Ask whether it contains oat flour.

safe_dishes.dish: Any pizza on the gluten-free crust (e.g. Cajun Chicken, Super Meat Deluxe)
safe_dishes.note: The Sotheby's guide says every one of its 26 pizzas can be made on a GF crust.

summary: A 2021 Khaleej Times piece, a Sotheby's guide and an Atly listing all say a GF crust is available for any pizza; I found nothing confirming it is still offered in 2026.
